title: Douay-Rheims Bible
notes: SITE FIXTURE, not the full corpus: only Genesis 1:1-13 and John 1:1-18, 3:1-21 are populated, mirroring bible.cpdv.en so the two can be compared. Present so the fixtures carry the case the real corpus has and the CPDV alone cannot show — a SECOND English Bible, which is what `PREFERRED_EDITION` in corpus.ts exists to decide between, and an annotated one: John 3 keeps all four of Challoner's notes, and every chapter its argument (`summary`). Note the markers repeat across verses (v5 and v18 both carry ⟦1⟧) because a marker is unique within its unit, not its chapter — see docs/corpus-schema.md.
